gates.title: Foundation
gates.done_when: CI is green, branch protection is on, docker compose up shows the board and a no-op job completes.

gates.title: Spec and render
gates.done_when: make demo-render turns the sample spec into a correct 45 second video inside the worker image.

gates.title: Pipeline and planning
gates.done_when: In demo mode an idea reaches the plan gate, is edited, approved and rendered through the interface.

gates.title: Assets and clips
gates.done_when: A live episode on the owner's PC passes the asset gate with generated images and at least three Wan 2.2 clips.

gates.title: QC and export
gates.done_when: The Render tab shows a QC report and the export zip opens with all five items.

gates.title: Videos and revision loop
gates.done_when: A video is adjusted once and remade once from the Videos screen, all three versions are playable, and Finish writes the export folder.

gates.title: Critic agent
gates.done_when: In demo mode a video with planted defects is auto-fixed, both versions are visible, and every guardrail test passes.

gates.title: Producer agent
gates.done_when: In demo mode an idea reaches the review gate on autopilot, and the producer cannot pass the final review or a rights flag.

gates.title: Showcase
gates.done_when: A stranger can run the demo from the README in under 10 minutes.

gates.title: Tracker published
gates.done_when: This page is published on the owner's hosting. Until then it is served locally only.
